versions.changelog: Channels: multi-media posts — 2-10 media per post published as a Telegram album (photos+videos mix, GIF solo, first item is cover); composer/inline editor multi-upload with reorder; 10-item media_limit behavior documented

Add channel post fact-verify feature (Gemini 2.5 Pro grounded search via per-channel Google AI key, OpenRouter fallback); related new 'google' provider on channel_provider_keys; new updateVerifyProviderPreference server action; D.9 scheduled-grace lockout. Schedule-branch wait-loop now handles accept/decline/unschedule actions correctly.
Add error.hint.action guidance for LLM agents — follow on 4xx to self-correct (e.g. refresh signal IDs on 404)

Drop Studio (post generation, humanize, publish/schedule/draft/queue, writing styles) — feature was removed from the API. Skill now focuses on signal monitoring, feed discovery, semantic search, and bookmark folders.
Fix signal creation, improve onboarding UX, auth error handling
Add folder management endpoints: create, rename, delete folders and add/remove tweets from folders
Fix: don't auto-include keywords (too restrictive), add color support, always set tags
Major restructure: lean SKILL.md (145 lines) + separate API_REFERENCE.md for progressive disclosure. Stronger output formatting rules. Better LLM compliance.
Move formatting rules to top of skill for better LLM compliance
Add formatting rules for clickable @mentions
Fix signal creation (auto-activate, ownership, cron/timezone), add schedule management to PUT /signals/:id, fix response shapes, correct feed response structure, use FTS-only search
